title: Wedding Dress Physique
author: Rahul Bhatt
desc:
Pure bodybuilding program I have built for my girlfriend. It follows a basic linear periodisation as well as double and dynamic double progression to drive progressive overload.
Get the dream Wonder Woman like physique, with an hourglass shape without the need to cut calories. If anything I’d suggest a slight surplus to build your lats, glutes and shoulders optimally. If you think you want to get slightly leaner first, you can go for a cut while running the program to minimise muscle loss and then run another cycle of this on a surplus.
Recommended training schedule: 
Monday: Train
Tuesday: Rest
Wednesday: Rest
Thursday : Train
Friday : Rest
Saturday : Train
Sunday: Rest

ex.note: 3sets of 10-15 reps

ss.note: Medium-Wide grip preferable. Lean forward during the eccentric to get a deep stretch and then explosively contract. 1st set is the heaviest, drop load by 10-12% on last two. Dont forget to warm up

Optional to super set, you can super set if you’re short on time or once you’re familiar with the movements. 1st set should be the heaviest, drop load by 10-20% on the last two sets. Warmup before 1st

ex.note:
Do as many reps as possible 
Preferably in 12-20 rep range, bodyweight only.
Incline Dumbell bench is the exercise you can use to load up

2-3 warmup sets. 
1st warmup - bar, 
2nd warmup -  60% of your top set for 5 reps.
 If you're strong add another warmup set, 80%, 3 reps
Drop weight by 12-15% on second working set after the top set
3sets of 10-15 reps
